Solutions

Portal Solutions

Browser-based applications, seamlessly integrated with SAP

Our portal solutions are browser-based applications that integrate directly with SAP — automating invoicing, collections and inter-plant transfers while keeping inventory and transactions reconciled with SAP every day, without manual intervention.

🧩
Carry & Forward Agency Business Solution
C&F ABS

C&F ABS is a browser-based application integrated with SAP; this application provides facility to create invoice, make collection entries and do inter-plant transfer. This system comes with an efficient inventory management system, which can be tallied with SAP every day. It also gives effective reports of Sales, Collection and Stock transactions. The key feature of this application is the seamless integration with SAP, which by every end of the day does all the transactions of this system in SAP without human interaction, and all relevant documents are created in SAP.

Privacy Policy

Effective 1 January 2015 · Client Linx Software Private Limited

On this page
1. Scope of This Policy 2. Consent 3. Information We Collect 4. How We Use Your Information 5. Legal Basis for Processing 6. Cookies and Log Files 7. Data Sharing & Disclosure 8. Data Retention 9. Client Linx Software Private Limited ("Client Linx", "CLSS", "CLSS Labs", "we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting the privacy, confidentiality, and security of personal data entrusted to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, store, and protect personal information when you:

  • Visit our website https://www.clsslabs.com/
  • Use our web applications, mobile applications, or internal enterprise tools
  • Are an employee, contractor, consultant, customer, partner, or authorised user of our systems

This Privacy Policy has been designed to comply with applicable Indian data protection laws, including the Information Technology Act, 2000 (India), and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India), with specific requirements related to location data collection.

1. Scope of This Policy

This Privacy Policy applies to:

  • Website visitors
  • Registered users of our applications
  • Employees and contractors using company-provided or BYOD devices
  • Business customers and partners

It does not apply to third-party websites or services that are not operated or controlled by Client Linx.

2. Consent

By accessing or using our website, applications, or services, you:

  • Acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy
  • Consent to the collection, use, processing, and storage of your personal data as described herein

Where required by law (including for location tracking), we obtain explicit, informed, and revocable consent through in-app permissions or written agreements.

3. Information We Collect

3.1 Personal Information

We may collect the following categories of personal data:

  • Identity Information: Name, employee ID, username, designation, company name
  • Contact Information: Email address, phone number, postal address
  • Account Information: Login credentials, role, access rights
  • Device Information: Device ID, operating system, app version, IP address
  • Communication Data: Emails, support tickets, chat messages, attachments

3.2 Employee & Workforce Data

For employees, contractors, and authorized workforce users, we may collect:

  • Employment details (role, department, reporting manager)
  • Attendance and shift data
  • Leave, travel, and work allocation details

3.3 Location Data (Critical Disclosure)

We collect location data only for authorized employees or workforce users, strictly for legitimate business purposes.

What location data we collect:

  • Approximate or precise location (GPS, network-based)
  • Timestamped check-in / check-out location

When location data is collected:

  • During working hours
  • When the employee explicitly checks in or uses work-related features
  • Only after explicit user permission is granted

Why we collect location data:

  • Attendance verification
  • Field workforce tracking
  • Travel and expense validation
  • Operational safety and compliance
Important assurances
  • Location tracking is not continuous or background surveillance unless explicitly enabled for a specific role
  • Location data is not used for advertising or profiling
  • Location data is not shared with third parties for marketing

Users may revoke location permission at any time through device settings; however, doing so may limit app functionality.

4. How We Use Your Information

We use personal data strictly for legitimate business and operational purposes, including:

  • Providing, operating, and maintaining our services
  • Identity verification and access control
  • Workforce management and compliance
  • Improving system performance and user experience
  • Communication related to support, operations, or service updates
  • Legal, regulatory, and audit compliance
  • Fraud detection and security monitoring

We do not sell personal data under any circumstances.

5. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)

We process personal data based on one or more of the following legal grounds:

  • User consent
  • Performance of a contract
  • Compliance with legal obligations
  • Legitimate business interests (without overriding user rights)

6. Cookies and Log Files

We use cookies and standard log files to:

  • Analyze usage trends
  • Administer systems
  • Improve security and performance

Collected data may include IP address, browser type, ISP, date/time stamp, and referring pages. This data is not directly identifiable.

Users may disable cookies via browser settings.

7. Data Sharing & Disclosure

We may share personal data only with:

  • Authorized internal teams
  • Trusted service providers (hosting, analytics, security) under strict confidentiality agreements
  • Government or regulatory authorities when legally required

We do not allow third-party advertisers to access employee or sensitive user data.

8. Data Retention

We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to:

  • Fulfill stated purposes
  • Meet legal, accounting, or audit requirements

Location data is retained for a limited, policy-defined duration and is securely deleted thereafter.

9. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures, including:

  • Role-based access control (RBAC)
  • Encryption at rest and in transit
  • Secure authentication and audit logs
  • Periodic security reviews and audits

Despite best efforts, no system can guarantee absolute security.

10. User Rights

In accordance with applicable Indian laws, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, users have the right to:

  • Access personal data held by us
  • Request correction of inaccurate or outdated data
  • Request erasure of personal data, subject to legal and operational requirements
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
  • Grievance redressal as per applicable law

Requests can be made by contacting us (see Section 14). We respond within timelines prescribed under Indian law.

11. Children's Privacy

Our services are not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If such data is identified, it will be promptly deleted.

12. Third-Party Links

Our website or apps may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices and encourage users to review their policies.

13. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

14. Contact Information

For privacy-related queries, requests, or complaints:
Client Linx Software Private Limited
Email: hr@clsslabs.com
Website: https://www.clsslabs.com/
Legal · Refund

Refund Policy

Client Linx Software Private Limited

Thank you for choosing Client Linx Software Private Limited. We provide Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions to business and individual customers across India. Payments are accepted through UPI and other approved payment methods for monthly subscriptions and usage-based services.

1. Nature of Service

Our services are digitally delivered and activated instantly upon successful payment. By completing the payment, the customer acknowledges and agrees to this Refund Policy.

2. General Refund Policy

As our services are activated immediately after payment, all payments made towards subscriptions, renewals, usage charges, upgrades, or add-on services are generally non-refundable.

3. Eligible Refund Cases

Refund requests may be considered only under the following circumstances:

  • Duplicate payment for the same service / order
  • Excess amount charged due to a system or technical error
  • Payment successfully received, but service not activated by our system
  • Unauthorized transaction reported with valid proof, subject to verification

4. Non-Refundable Cases

Refunds will not be provided in the following cases:

  • Partial or unused subscription period
  • Non-usage of service after activation
  • Change of mind after purchase
  • Misunderstanding of product features prior to purchase
  • Delay or issues caused by user-side internet, device, or browser settings
  • Violation of Terms of Service resulting in suspension or termination
  • Usage-based charges already consumed

5. Refund Request Timeline

All refund requests must be submitted within 7 days from the date of transaction.

6. How to Request a Refund

Customers may submit refund requests by email with the following details:

  • Name / Company Name
  • Registered Mobile Number / Email ID
  • Transaction ID / UPI Reference Number
  • Amount Paid
  • Date of Payment
  • Account Number and IFSC Code
  • GST Number (if applicable)
  • Reason for Refund Request

Email: Finance@clsslabs.com

7. Processing Time

If approved, the refund will be processed within 7 to 10 business days to the original payment source or an eligible bank account.

8. Final Decision

Client Linx Software Private Limited reserves the right to review all refund requests individually and make the final decision based on payment records, service logs, and internal verification.

9. Contact Us

For billing or payment-related assistance:
Client Linx Software Private Limited
Email: Finance@clsslabs.com

Capabilities

Everything procurement and vendors need, in one place

From the first registration to the final payment, the portal digitises every step of supplier collaboration and keeps SAP as the single source of truth.

🧾
Vendor Onboarding

Guided self-registration with company, contact and banking details, document uploads, and a configurable multi-level approval workflow.

🔄
SAP Master-Data Sync

Two-way alignment with SAP — vendor codes, plants, regions, GL accounts and more — with GSTN-based linking and auto-approval for SAP-created vendors.

📋
RFQ & E-Auctions

Create RFQs (incl. from SAP purchase requisitions), run sealed, reverse-auction or hybrid bidding, and convert the winning bid straight into an SAP purchase order.

💰
Bid Evaluation

Side-by-side price comparison, vendor nomination with approval, bid-revision history, and reduction tracking across auction rounds.

📑
Invoicing & FI

Vendor PO-invoices and non-PO FI invoices, PDF upload, posting to SAP, and a live account statement reconciled from the vendor ledger.

🛡️
KYC Verification

Validate GSTIN, PAN/CIN, bank account and MSME details against external sources, with a per-vendor verification report.

How it works

A clear path from supplier to settlement

1

Register & verify

Vendors self-register and upload KYC documents; the system verifies and routes for multi-level approval.

2

Source & bid

Buyers publish RFQs; vendors submit quotations and compete in sealed or reverse auctions.

3

Award & order

The nominated bid is approved and converted into an SAP purchase order automatically.

4

Invoice & pay

Vendors invoice against POs; invoices post to SAP and reconcile on the account statement.

Powered by AI

Less data entry. Faster, better decisions.

Generative AI is woven into the day-to-day work — turning documents into structured data and surfacing insight from quotations.

Extract

Invoice auto-fill

Upload an invoice PDF and the form pre-fills — number, date, amount, line items matched to the PO — for the vendor to review and submit.

Compare

Quotation analysis

In bid evaluation, AI compares every vendor's quotation against the RFQ document and produces a compliance & recommendation report.

Onboard

Profile auto-fill

Vendor name, address, GSTIN, MSME and bank details are read straight from the uploaded certificates and cheque using generative AI.

Security & Governance

Enterprise-grade by design

Role-based access, full auditability and SAP as the system of record — so finance and procurement stay in control.

  • Role-based access for buyers, managers, finance, master-data and vendors
  • Multi-level approval workflows with change-request governance
  • Complete activity log and audit trail on every record
  • Deploys on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry) or standalone Docker
  • Vendor data validated against statutory sources before approval
